There's a Meerian Hammerhead over there... and a Stofo Lupinoid, couple of T'iin-T'iin Dwarfs...|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Radio script">[[Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Star Wars'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref>}}
A '''Stofo Lupinoid''' was a name for a [[Wolf/Legends|wolflike]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. On entering for the first time [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] identified one of the customers as a Stofo Lupinoid.<ref name="The Millennium Falcon Deal">{{SWRadio|The Millennium Falcon Deal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the Stofo Lupinoid first appeared in "[[The Millennium Falcon Deal]]," the sixth episode of the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]], and later in the [[Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization|radio drama's published script]]. The episode, first aired in [[1981]], named a few previously-unidentified Cantina patrons that would later be given different [[canon]]ical names. The Cantina scenes in {{Film|IV}} include two lupinoid or wolflike ailens, both of which received different names for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that subsequent ''Star Wars'' media have continued to use. One, the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanean]], was named in [[1989]]'s ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''. The second, the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]], was identified in 1989's ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''. No source ever established whether the name "Stofo," mentioned in a line by Luke Skywalker, was an alternative name for one of these two species, or a third species which Luke thought he recognized by mistake.
